title: A precise promise allows different feelings
meaning: You can gently clarify a promise and preserve honest agreement even while feelings about its precise meaning change.
text: Strength in the physical position of your Vishuddha helps clarify important words without harsh pressure or abandoning a direct question. Justice in energy supports the wish to match a promise with what you genuinely accepted. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions brings a changing response. Clarification may first reassure you and later bring regret about an expectation never expressed. Different feelings do not necessarily mean an honestly named condition has stopped applying.

For example, you discuss a promise to listen to a new song. You can gently clarify that agreeing to hear it did not mean promising to learn the words and sing together. **An honest promise’s meaning does not require an unchanging mood**. The distinction first seems obvious, then may feel sad because singing together was what you wanted. You can name that wish separately rather than attribute it retrospectively to the initial agreement. Conversation gains both a precise answer and a genuine emotional response still changing.

Confusion returns if every new sadness is treated as an accusation of breaking a promise. Calm clarification then becomes another defence of being right although the condition is not disputed. Constructive Justice helps distinguish the scope of agreement from experiencing a wish. You can preserve accurate words while leaving room for regret; an honest answer does not require immediate delight about something neither promised nor received.
